report:
getting error: invalid column name after upgrading debezium oracle to 2.6.0

Hi,
we were using debezium oracle connector 2.5 for capturing changes on oracle 11 server and everything worked well, we wanted to upgrade debezium to the new version (2.6) for using the new hybrid mining strategy, we did so and we encountered the following error:
io.debezium.DebeziumException: Failed to read the Oracle database redo thread state
Caused by: java.sql.SQLException: Invalid column name
was the unofficial support for oracle 11 was broken? we would love some assistance.

evidence.quote: Oracle 11 support temporarily broken from 2.6.0.Final. This will be fixed in Debezium 2.6.1.Final

notes: Regression in 2.6.0 query for redo thread state on Oracle 11 (Invalid column name); fixed in 2.6.1.
